findings.note: Quoted in a caucus news release on SB21-256 after a House vote; she says she has worked on ending mass shootings and gun violence and that the Boulder shooting made action more pressing.

findings.note: Quoted in the same caucus release; she describes SB21-256 as letting local governments set higher gun safety standards than the state.
